run_classifier_on_documents: run the Classifier transformer to predict language labels on JSON documents using a fasttext model
predict_language_from_text: use the predict function to get language labels and scores from a fasttext model for given text
avg_predict_multiline_text: use avg_predict to compute a weighted average language prediction across multiple lines of text
classify_and_split_json_files: run classify_and_split to classify documents by language and split them into separate output files
review_classifier_disagreement: review the Classifier summary to check language label disagreement rates and document acceptance ratios
